courses.overview: 從多極磁路、氣隙偏心與垂直軸承延伸至相近領域；相似物理不代表同一設備規格或驗收程序。
courses.overviewEn: Extend multipolar magnetics, air-gap eccentricity and vertical bearings to neighboring domains; shared physics does not imply identical equipment requirements or acceptance procedures.

related.title: 汽輪發電機製造
related.why: 同為同步電機與三相熱設計
related.whyEn: Both use synchronous machines and three-phase thermal design
related.transfer: 同為同步電機與三相熱設計
related.transferEn: Both use synchronous machines and three-phase thermal design
related.difference: 汽輪發電機的高速圓筒轉子不同
related.differenceEn: Steam generators use different high-speed cylindrical rotors
practice: 以「水頭與功率」為起點，畫出本課與「汽輪發電機製造」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「汽輪發電機的高速圓筒轉子不同」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from head and power and mark shared/redefined boundaries with steam-turbine generator manufacturing.
For the difference "Steam generators use different high-speed cylindrical rotors", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.

related.title: 同步調相機
related.why: 勵磁及無功能力可互相比較
related.whyEn: Excitation and reactive capability are comparable
related.transfer: 勵磁及無功能力可互相比較
related.transferEn: Excitation and reactive capability are comparable
related.difference: 水輪機持續提供軸功率而調相機主要吸收損失
related.differenceEn: Hydro supplies shaft power while a condenser mainly absorbs losses
practice: 以「水頭與功率」為起點，畫出本課與「同步調相機」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「水輪機持續提供軸功率而調相機主要吸收損失」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from head and power and mark shared/redefined boundaries with synchronous condensers.
For the difference "Hydro supplies shaft power while a condenser mainly absorbs losses", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.
